record.title: Using the Record Screen
record.intro:
<star/>, <check/>, and <question/> can be marked with a single tap, without looking at the screen.
Long-press to pick from a list of recent lines and mark one instead.
Use <camera/> to take a slide photo, and <pencil/> to leave a short memo.

pauseVsEnd.heading: Pause vs. Stop
pauseVsEnd.bullet1: "Pause" means the recording is still in progress. It's only saved as a note once you press "Stop".
pauseVsEnd.bullet2: The elapsed-time timer also pauses. It resumes counting from where it left off.

multipleMarks.heading: You can add more than one mark
multipleMarks.bullet1: Important, To-Do, and Question marks can all be added to the same line. Marked lines are shown with distinct colors and icons.
multipleMarks.bullet2: In the long-press "choose from recent lines" mode, auto-scrolling stops, so you can calmly pick an earlier line.

autoScroll.heading: Auto-Scroll and the New Arrivals Badge
autoScroll.bullet1: The timeline normally auto-scrolls to the bottom every time a new line appears.
autoScroll.bullet2: Auto-scrolling pauses while a long-press menu is open, and a "↓ N new" badge appears if there's anything new off-screen.

sectionGrouping.heading: Section Breaks (Paragraphs)
sectionGrouping.bullet1: A gap between lines longer than a set amount of time automatically starts a new section. You can turn this on/off and adjust the interval in Settings.
sectionGrouping.bullet2: The setting in effect when a recording starts is used for that whole recording, and can't be changed mid-recording.

interruptedRecording.heading: If a Recording Ends Unexpectedly
interruptedRecording.bullet1: If the app is force-quit, the next time you open it you can choose to "resume the previous recording," "just view its contents," or "discard it".
interruptedRecording.bullet2: A recording with no lines, marks, photos, or audio at all is discarded automatically, without asking.

sleepMode.heading: Sleep Mode
sleepMode.bullet1: Tap the moon icon in the top right to switch to a power-saving mode that dims the screen and shows only the most recent lines. Useful when recording with the phone in your pocket.
sleepMode.bullet2: To exit, long-press the screen. The screen gradually brightens as you hold, and returns to normal once you've held it long enough (a light accidental touch won't exit it). Tapping the moon icon in the header exits it immediately.
sleepMode.bullet3: Pause, stop, marking as important, and taking photos can still be done from the buttons at the bottom, even in Sleep Mode.

resetButton.heading: The Reset Button
resetButton.bullet1: The "Reset" button shown while recording discards everything recorded so far (transcript, memos, photos, audio) without saving it, and returns to the idle state. Useful if you started recording by mistake.
resetButton.bullet2: Choosing "Reset" in the confirmation dialog can't be undone. If you want to keep what you've recorded, use "Stop" instead.

audioInterference.heading: About Interfering with Other Apps' Audio
audioInterference.bullet1: This app may briefly interrupt other apps' audio in order to record and recognize speech. Regular phone calls aren't affected, but in some special situations — like Split View on iPad or Picture-in-Picture playback — video or music playback may be interrupted intermittently.

noteDetail.title: Using the Note Detail Screen
noteDetail.intro:
Tap a line to play the audio from that point.
Long-press to edit the text, or to merge or split it with a neighboring line.
Use the filter at the top to show only <star/> or <question/> items.
noteDetail.diagramTapCaption: Tap → play audio from that point
noteDetail.diagramFilterCaption: Filter using the bar at the top

longPressMenu.heading: The Long-Press Menu Changes by Line Type
longPressMenu.bullet1: Depending on the type of line, extra options appear: "Short Note" and "Set Group" for important lines, "Add an Answer" for questions, "Mark as Done" for to-dos, and so on.
longPressMenu.bullet2: You can also copy the text from here.

mergeSplit.heading: Merge and Split
mergeSplit.bullet1: "Merge with Previous" and "Merge with Next" combine neighboring lines into one (photo entries can't be merged).
mergeSplit.bullet2: When merging, Important, To-Do, and Question marks carry over from both lines.
mergeSplit.bullet3: "Split" divides the text into two at the character position you tap (only for lines with 2 or more characters).

summaryTab.heading: The "Summary" Tab on This Screen
summaryTab.bullet1: The "Summary" tab at the top is separate from the Summary screen (the one in the tab bar). It shows only this note's important lines, questions, to-dos, photos, and memos, grouped by type.

noAudioNotice.heading: The "No Audio" Notice
noAudioNotice.bullet1: This appears if the audio was lost because the app was force-quit, or if you deleted just the audio via Storage Management. Either way, the text record itself is still intact.

export.heading: Export
export.bullet1: Use the export icon in the top right to choose "Excerpt (Important, To-Do, and Questions only)" or "Full Text," then copy, share, or save it as a file.
export.bullet2: What the symbols mean in the exported text: ★ = an important line, ❓ = a question, 📝 = a memo. To-dos use two symbols, ☑️ (not done) and ✅ (done), to show completion status.
export.bullet3: In the Excerpt version, ★, ❓, and 📝 appear only once, as section headings (not repeated per line). Only the To-Do ☑️/✅ appears on each line, since its completion status can differ line by line. Photos are shown as the text "(Photo)" rather than an emoji.

summary.title: Using the Summary Screen
summary.intro:
See pending to-dos, unresolved questions, and important lines
gathered across all your training sessions and meetings.

hiddenByDefault.heading: Completed and Resolved Items Are Hidden by Default
hiddenByDefault.bullet1: Completed to-dos stay hidden until you open "Show completed".
hiddenByDefault.bullet2: Only unresolved questions show at first, too. Open "Show resolved & deferred" to see the rest.

deferQuestion.heading: Questions Can Be Deferred
deferQuestion.bullet1: If you want to keep a question without deleting it but get it out of the list for now, use "Defer".

groupedStars.heading: Important Items Can Be Grouped
groupedStars.bullet1: Important lines given the same group name are combined into a single card, even across different notes.

itemToNote.heading: From an Item to Its Original Note
itemToNote.bullet1: Tap an item to edit its content, or tap the note icon to jump to that spot in the original note.
itemToNote.bullet2: On the To-Do and Question tabs, use the + button in the bottom left to add one on the spot, without recording.

notesList.title: Using the Notes List
notesList.intro:
Browse your past recordings as a list or a calendar. The search bar
also searches line content (searches of 2 characters or fewer aren't supported).
notesList.diagramSearchHint: Searches of 2 characters or fewer aren't supported

bulkSelect.heading: Select Multiple Notes to Delete
bulkSelect.bullet1: Long-press a card in the List tab to enter selection mode (or use "Edit" in the top right).
bulkSelect.bullet2: While in selection mode, each note's storage usage (audio + photos) is shown.
bulkSelect.bullet3: Deleting a note removes its audio, photos, and memos completely — this can't be undone.

calendarView.heading: Calendar View
calendarView.bullet1: A blue dot under a date means there's a recording that day.
calendarView.bullet2: Tap the month label to pick a year and month directly (months with recordings are shown in bold).
calendarView.bullet3: Bulk selection isn't available in the Calendar tab, but long-press to open or delete still works.

settings.title: Settings & Backup
settings.intro:
An overview of what you can adjust from the Settings screen — playback
behavior, recording quality, backups — and what each one means.

leadTime.heading: Playback Lead Time
leadTime.bullet1: How many seconds before a line playback starts when you tap to play in Note Detail, so you don't miss the beginning of what was said.

sampleRate.heading: Recording Sample Rate
sampleRate.bullet1: Choose between Standard (smaller files) and High Quality (larger files).
sampleRate.bullet2: Changes take effect starting with your next recording, and don't affect notes you've already recorded.

bluetoothMic.heading: Use External Microphone
bluetoothMic.bullet1: Turn this on when using Bluetooth earbuds or a pin mic.
bluetoothMic.bullet2: Leave it off if you want to pick up sound broadly from the room, using the phone's own mic.

sectionGroupingSettings.heading: Show Section Breaks / Default Interval for New Recordings
sectionGroupingSettings.bullet1: Whether the Record screen automatically starts a new paragraph when there's a gap between lines, and the default length of that gap.
sectionGroupingSettings.bullet2: Changing this doesn't affect the breaks in existing notes — it only applies the next time you start a recording.

storageManagement.heading: Storage Management
storageManagement.bullet1: Check how much storage each note is using.
storageManagement.bullet2: "Delete Audio Only" removes just the audio while keeping the text record (can't be undone).
storageManagement.bullet3: There's also a cleanup feature that removes unused files that aren't referenced by any note.

backupRestore.heading: Creating and Restoring Backups
backupRestore.bullet1: A backup includes the database, audio, and photos (exported report files are not included).
backupRestore.bullet2: Restoring overwrites all current data in the app. You'll always be asked to confirm before it happens.
backupRestore.bullet3: After a restore finishes, restart the app for the changes to take effect.

record.title: Say It, and It's Recorded
record.description: Speech is recognized and turned into text, saved as a note.

timeline.title: ★, Photos, and Audio in One Timeline
timeline.description: Mark important lines with ★ and drop in photos as you go, then look back at everything together in order.

local.title: Fully Local, Zero Network Use
local.description: Recording and transcription both happen entirely on your device. No data is ever sent anywhere.

consent.heading: Before You Start
consent.notice1: Always follow the organizer's permission and any rules for recording or taking photos at an event.
consent.notice2: You're responsible for how you use anything you record or photograph.

permission.heading: Microphone Access
permission.description: Please allow microphone access so speech can be recognized and turned into text.
permission.deniedMessage: You can allow it anytime later from the Settings app.

storageManagement.empty: No notes with audio or photos
